testCases.title: Test case results (all 124, including Skipped and Excluded)

categories.name: A. Getting to the seat map

cases.title: You can only pick seats on step 2

rows.label: Observed
rows.value: Step names are '01 Passenger Info' and '02 Ancillaries'. The first is not called '...and Bundles' because this supplier has no bundles. No Select Seat control before step 2.

cases.title: You cannot reach the seats without choosing a fare package

rows.label: Reason
rows.value: Precondition not met: AegeanNdc has no fare packages (Bundle = Not Supported), so there is no package to leave unchosen. Next moves on without any bundle message.

cases.title: Missing passenger details and a missing fare package are both reported

rows.label: Observed
rows.value: Part 1 observed: empty step 1 shows 'Required' under 27 empty boxes and step 2 stays Upcoming. Part 2 (bundle message) does not apply to this supplier.

cases.title: 'Select Seat' opens the seat map

rows.label: Observed
rows.value: Map opens full screen titled 'Seat Map CAI -> ATH Onward - Leg 1'. Left panel, chart, colour key and bottom button are all there.

cases.title: You can skip seats completely

rows.label: Observed
rows.value: 'Continue without seats' closes the map, gives nobody a seat and leaves the price unchanged (38,634.6). Booking can still be finished.

cases.title: A supplier with no seat selection shows no seat option

rows.label: Reason
rows.value: Not supported by supplier: Only for suppliers without Seat — this supplier supports it

categories.name: B. How the map is drawn

cases.title: Every seat has one clear state and one seat number

rows.label: Observed

cases.title: A taken seat can be looked at but not booked

rows.label: Observed

cases.title: Seat features use known wording

rows.label: Reason
rows.value: Suite lists six feature words. The map sends 19 more (for example Pet cabin, Crew seat, Deportee, Overwing seat(s), Seat not allowed for infant). The list in the suite was written from flynas, so this is a documentation gap, not an application defect.

cases.title: Window and aisle labels match where the seat really is

rows.label: Observed
rows.value: No window/aisle mismatch across 33 rows of a 3-3 layout (A/F window, C/D aisle, B/E middle).

cases.title: Emergency exit seats are marked

items.body: Seat features use known wording. Suite lists six feature words. The map sends 19 more (for example Pet cabin, Crew seat, Deportee, Overwing seat(s), Seat not allowed for infant). The list in the suite was written from flynas, so this is a documentation gap, not an application defect.

A seat marked 'Chargeable seat' must always have a price. On leg 2 of A3650, all 107 seats marked Chargeable seat are offered Free. Seat 19A booked at EGP 0. Leg 1 is correct. No Plus/Value packages here.

Opening the booking page with a broken or missing link. Expired link: page 'No Data Found' (HTTP 400), not the flight search. Altered link: same. Missing link: sent to login and the session was ended. No map or prices shown, no technical error page.

Closed passenger sections still report missing information. Closed section hides its boxes, and Expand All / Collapse All work. But several sections can be open at once, and Next with a closed incomplete passenger shows no message.
An adult with an infant CANNOT take an exit seat. Adult linked to an infant was offered exit seats 17A and 28A and could book 17A. The seat description itself says Seat not allowed for infant.

The rule follows the infant's linked adult. With the infant linked to adult A, 18C was bookable for A and B. After relinking to B it was still bookable for both. The refusal does not follow the Assigned-to link.

Seat and ancillary charges should be identifiable per journey. One base-fare line, one seat line (+3,367) and one tax line cover both journeys. The total is right but charges cannot be told apart per journey.

Going back a step must not silently throw away seats and ancillaries. Editing a passenger's document number on step 1, then Next: Net Payable fell from 41,935.4 to 37,093.4 - all seats and the bag were dropped with no warning. Known fault reproduced.

Two infant-holding adults cannot sit in the same set of seats. Two infant-holding adults: 12A (Rana) then 12B (Tarek) in the same ABC set were both offered, booked and confirmed with no warning. The suite records this as 'Pass by decision' because the airline enforces it at booking. Cannot be checked without a real booking.

Extra baggage is offered per passenger and per journey. Adult and child each have a list of 32 options with prices, but no option shows a weight. Options are Aegean special-item descriptions plus three free-text request items at 0 EGP. Suite wording expects weights, so this may be a documentation gap.
A payment appears in the account statement with the right amount. Statement report has no debit row for the booking payment, and a search by its transaction ID finds nothing (same as run-007).

sections.title: Known Limitations
blocks: No booking, hold or payment was run (Execution Safety Policy). No Traceability Matrix exists, so requirement coverage is not computed.
